model: X-AIRCONTROL Master zone controller (TROX Auranor, BACnet IP)
equipment_type: VAV zone controller (master for up to 25 zone modules)
applies_to: TROX Auranor X-AIRCONTROL VAV zone control systems: one Master with up to 25 Zone Modules, linked to an AHU.
summary: The X-AIRCONTROL Master has a built-in BACnet IP server (program version 1.00 and later). The protocol document lists 824 objects: AHU and section values (fan and temperature setpoints sent to the AHU, alarms, outdoor temperature, most-open damper/valve positions), per-zone readings and setpoints for up to 25 Zone Modules, master-chain alarms and the system clock. Values are scaled integers (for example 1/100 % and 1/100 °C).
default_device_instance: Last 5 digits of the IP address
notes: Zone objects repeat per Zone Module: instance = 1000 + (zone - 1) x 100 + offset, zones 1-25 (all printed in the document). Master alarm objects repeat as 4000 + (master - 1) x 100.
Most values are scaled integers: % values run 0-10000 (1/100 %) and temperatures -4000..10000 (1/100 °C); airflows are m³/h.
Access follows the section headings: Binary Value and Analog Value are read/write, Analog Input and Binary Input are read-only.
Objects for zone modules that are not connected stay unused; AI 300 gives the number of connected modules.
AV 104 and AV 105 have no unit in the unit column; the remarks give them in 1/100 °C.
The PDF cover page uses a garbled font; the tables themselves extract cleanly.

integration.summary: Read AI 111 for the master operating mode, AI 104 for the AHU state and AI 109/AI 110 for master and zone-module alarms. Per zone, write the room temperature setpoint (AV 1001 for zone 1, +100 per zone) and read room temperature (AI 1009), supply airflow (AI 1002) and zone status (AI 1000). Remember that values are scaled by 100.

minimum_points.name: Zone Master Operation Mode
minimum_points.why: Master mode: normal, standby, night, fire...

minimum_points.name: AHU status
minimum_points.why: 0 normal, 1 stop, 2 summer night cooling, 3 fire

minimum_points.name: Section Zone Module Alarm Status
minimum_points.why: Zone module alarm: 0 none, 1 B-alarm, 2 A-alarm

setup: BACnet IP over the Master's RJ45 port; the device Object_Identifier is set automatically from the last five digits of the IP address (e.g. 172.21.0.95 gives 95).
Up to 300 values can be subscribed for COV.
TROX Norway offers the PICS and EDE files for the Master.
gotchas: Scaled values: divide % and °C values by 100.
Changing the Master IP address changes its BACnet device instance.
